newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes little changed in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes little changed in dull trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar ended almost unchanged against its U.S. counterpart in quiet Saturday trade as players retreated to the sidelines due to the lack of market-moving factors, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.493 against Friday's T$27.494 close. It hovered in a tight T$27.492-494 range throughout the session. Turnover was a lifeless US$39 million.
"It's a typical quiet Saturday session, trading interest barely exists," said one dealer at a foreign bank. A narrow range of T$27.48-$27.51 was expected next week, dealers said.
